text: MatrixView now has storage-preserving row selection for dense, sparse, lazy-affine, and transposed views. ModelStudy.subset no longer densifies, fold train/validation views are prepared once and reused across candidates, and MatrixViewLinearMap uses direct vector kernels instead of allocating a one-column matrix and result. Focused storage/ModelSpec/operator suites passed 34/34 on JVM and JS.
